about: The generic asset pack's 3D objects: abstract sculptural forms, archetypal imagery, and non-sequitur objects from past, present and future. Each is generated from a concept image with TRELLIS.2.
style: single object, centred, whole object in frame, three-quarter view from slightly above, soft even studio light, plain light grey seamless background, no text, no logo, no people, no shadow clutter, product photograph
